221830.tob_value:
Covered through Assist America 
(Ref no: 97-AL-LIV-1251U)
(Please download the APP) (Covered only on direct billing) 

This benefit pays for the following services:  
•	Emergency Medical Evacuation 
If appropriate care is not available, Assist America will safely evacuate the members to the nearest facility that meets our rigorous standards. 
•	Medical Repatriation 
When deemed medically necessary, Assist America provides transportation home or to a specified health facility with a medical or non-medical escort as required. 
•	Return of Mortal Remains 
In the event that a member passes away, Assist America will arrange and pay for the required documents, remains preparation and transport to bring the mortal remains to a funeral home near the member’s place of residence. 
•	Lost Luggage and Document Assistance  
Assist America works with airlines to recover lost bags and replace lost travel tickets. We contact necessary agencies to solve issues of lost passports and other documents.  
•	Mobile App Services  
Assist America offers Mobile App services including electronic membership cards, "TAP FOR HELP" calling feature, embassy and consulate locator, service descriptions, pre-trip information and Assist Alerts. 
 
General 24/7 International Helpline 
Inside USA (toll free): 800-9095868 
Outside USA (collect call): +1-6094527508 
Email: jbreiss@assistamerica.com 
Website: http://www.assistamerica.com/services2020 

It is always advisable that members download our mobile application so they can call our operation center via the app through a standard call or VOIP (Voice over the internet). 
Members can call upon Assist America for services when they travel above 120 kilometers away from home or in a foreign country for up to 90 consecutive days.

Inpatient Maternity Treatments are subject to prior approval
221844.tob_value:
IP Treatments covered with NIL co-pay up to AED 25,000 PPPY

OP treatment is covered with 10% co-pay up to Annual limit. 

We would allow Treatment of the following as eligible:
• Ectopic Pregnancy (where the foetus is growing outside the womb)
• Hydatid form mole (abnormal cell growth in the womb)
• Retained placenta (afterbirth retained in the womb)
• Placenta Previa
• Eclampsia (a coma or seizure during Pregnancy and following pre-eclampsia)
• Diabetes (If You have exclusions because of Your past medical history which relate to diabetes, then You will not be covered for any Treatment for diabetes during Pregnancy)
• Post-partum hemorrhage (heavy bleeding in the hours and days immediately after childbirth)
• Miscarriage requiring immediate surgical Treatment

We will only pay for treatment of post-natal complications, when the treatment is received within 90 days following the delivery.
